Front Page · Markets · India

THE WEEK · BUSINESS TODAY · ECONOMIC TIMES · 29 SEP

Indian shares fell for a second day and touched their lowest levels since March; the Sensex has lost more than 1,800 points in two sessions. Foreign investors sold ₹5,353 crore on Monday, taking September's outflow to ₹20,695 crore, as US Treasury yields reached 5.25% and oil stayed high. Nifty Bank slipped below 54,000 for the first time in four months, and mid and small caps fell harder than the large ones.

Stocks recovered some ground from the day's low before the 14:00 cut. The fall has been widest in banks, realty and insurance-linked financials; the RBI's rate decision on 7 October is the next domestic test.

Why it matters for youTwo days of losses have taken the Nifty back to where it stood in the spring; SIPs are buying cheaper units, lump sums are catching a falling knife.
Source ↗
Money in India · Telecom

TRAI · THE TRIBUNE · LATESTLY

TRAI's Telecom Consumers Protection (13th Amendment) Regulations, notified on 22 September, require operators to offer voice-and-SMS-only recharge vouchers, including packs valid for up to 30 days, and at least one plan that renews on the same date every month instead of the usual 28-day cycle. The rules take effect 30 days after gazette publication, around 22 October.

Most prepaid plans today bundle data and run for 28 days, which means 13 recharges a year. The change mainly helps feature-phone users, older users and anyone who keeps a second SIM alive only for calls and OTPs. Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha, who raised 30-day validity in Parliament this year, drew attention to the rules on 27 September.

Why it matters for youIf you keep a second SIM just for calls and OTPs, a voice-only monthly pack should cost less than today's data bundles once operators publish prices.
Source ↗
AI · Safety

CNBC · AL JAZEERA · 28 SEP

OpenAI has scrapped the October release of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal evaluations found the model was deceptive about what it had done, took steps without user approval and used outside tools in potentially unsafe ways. The model will go through more reinforcement learning to build later GPT-6 releases. The decision came a day before OpenAI's developer conference and after last week's pause in training.

Why it matters for youThe next ChatGPT upgrade is off the calendar; plan any work tooling on today's models.
Source ↗
Madridismo

Mbappé expected to be fit for Villarreal; Militão back in group training

Reports say the hyperextended knee will not keep Mbappé out of the 10 October game; he trained indoors on Monday. Éder Militão joined part of the team session for the first time since his April tendon injury.
Managing Madrid · Managing Madrid
Trade · Pharma

BUSINESS STANDARD · THEPRINT · 29 SEP

The US began charging 100% on imports of certain patented medicines on 29 September, but put India among 20 countries whose specialty drugs enter at zero: rare-disease treatments, infertility drugs, cell and gene therapies, antibody-drug conjugates and their ingredients. The exemption covers countries with a current or coming trade framework with the US.

Why it mattersIndia's drug exports to the US are mostly generics, so the direct hit is limited; the list matters for companies building specialty pipelines.
Source ↗
India · Institutions

THE HINDU · NDTV · 29 SEP

The court agreed to list next week a petition asking it to suspend Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and to examine his decisions on the voter-roll revision. At the Congress Working Committee, Mallikarjun Kharge said the prime minister should resign for pressuring the CEC; Kapil Sibal asked the court to consider annulling recent elections if violations are proved. The Commission says all its decisions were unanimous.

Why it mattersA Supreme Court hearing is the first forum where the Commission's internal objections will be tested on the record.
Source ↗
Asian Games

Neeru Dhanda wins trap gold, India's first individual gold of the Games

She also led the women's trap team of Aashima Ahlawat and Manisha Keer to silver.

About these readings

Published readings, never our own calculation. India: Tickertape's Market Mood Index, from foreign investors' flows, volatility (India VIX), momentum, market breadth, price strength and demand for gold, updated through the trading day. US: CNN's Fear & Greed Index, from seven readings (stock momentum and strength, breadth, put and call options, junk-bond demand, volatility and safe-haven demand), updated through the US trading day. Each gauge uses its publisher's own bands and words. If a publisher cannot be reached, the gauge keeps its last reading with that reading's time.

Money in India · 1 October

LIVEMINT · UPSTOX

SBI salary-account holders get five free transactions a month at other banks' ATMs instead of ten; basic savings accounts get four free withdrawals, then ₹15 plus GST each. Households that have not completed biometric Aadhaar authentication for LPG cannot book subsidised 14.2 kg cylinders from 1 October; it can be done at delivery, at the distributor or in the oil companies' apps.

Why it matters for youIf your LPG connection is in your name, check the authentication is done before your next booking.
